title: Fix bad usage of default sphinx role
body:
We have a lot of formatting errors (particularly around the release notes/changelog) where the sphinx default role is used for what's supposed to be code snippets, but the default role is actually math.

This MR updates all the places where we use the default role so we instead either use double-backtick (code) or explicit `:math:`.

Maybe we can forbid the use of the default role (or we change it so it produces code snippets).

This was fixed semiautomatically using some hacky script + manual review.
